name: JellyGlance backup
description: Last backup hint from Glance settings.

displayConfig.template:
<Stack gap="sm" p="xs">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center">
    <Group gap="xs">
      <Avatar src="https://jellyglance.com/project-logo.png" size={24} radius="xl" />
      <Stack gap={0}>
        <Text fw={800} size="sm">Backup</Text>
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{data.kind}</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
    <Badge variant="light" color={data.configured ? "teal" : "orange"}>{data.configured ? "Set" : "Local"}</Badge>
  </Group>
  <Card withBorder radius="md" p="sm">
    <Text size="sm">{data.backupAt}</Text>
  </Card>
</Stack>
